title: Text Summarizer
description: A sophisticated text summarization tool powered by AI that condenses lengthy articles and documents into concise summaries while maintaining key information and context. The project utilizes advanced NLP techniques and machine learning algorithms to generate accurate and coherent summaries.

title: Job Application Tracker
description: A simple python terminal program that uses the inquirer package to create a user-friendly interface to help users keep track of their job applications. Users can add, view, update, and delete job applications, as well as store relevant details such as company name, position, application date, status, and notes. The program saves the data in a SQLite database for easy retrieval and management.

title: School Website
description: This is a website I built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It is a minimalistic website that allows users to view the history of my school. It was part of my Extended Project Qualification (EPQ) in Year 12 for which I received a grade of A*.

title: Portfolio Website
description: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with Jekyll and Bootstrap. Features include dark mode support, smooth animations, and a clean, professional design. The site showcases my projects, skills, and professional experience.
